audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and 6 were given to Vladimir at 8/10 while their own explanations describe Illaoi punishing you ('her tentacle slaps and Harsh Lesson punish your approaches', 'at 6 Leap of Faith's tentacle field is her hard power peak'). The page also carried a HARD difficulty label with a chart showing you winning five of seven stages.
audit.why: The mirror audit on illaoi__vladimir settled it as Vladimir / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Vladimir — you take level 1, she owns the stretch from 2 through her level-6 peak, and you take over on items. That matches the prose and the 54.61% overall.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 flipped to Illaoi as matched win[N] + phases[N].side pairs with the inflated 8/10 ratings rescaled, and whys[2] and whys[3] rewritten to state her advantage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit is named the matchup-defining cooldown on six fields with no number and no range, and Leap of Faith's cost was never given.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12 at 900 range against your 600-range Transfusion, so she opens every trade from outside your reach. Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 down to 70s. Harsh Lesson is only 4 seconds.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and whys[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to pool out of the tentacle field without saying what that actually buys you, and never mentioned that Harsh Lesson is an auto-attack reset on a 4-second cooldown.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetability; Harsh Lesson is 4 seconds and causes nearby tentacles to swing at the target. So pooling out of her ult does not reset the fight — she re-engages the instant you surface. That is the single most decision-changing fact in the matchup and the mirror states it from her side.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is in report[8].t but dontsFull[1].d — the 'Get E'd near a vessel' entry — carried unrelated boilerplate.
audit.why: Tentacles heal Illaoi whenever they damage a champion, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the heal and the buy.
